stepTitle: After the first reassignment of cluster centers in k-Medians, where are the new cluster centers located?
stepBody: Suppose the professors have a dataset with one feature $$x$$ that takes the values $$1$$, $$1$$, $$1$$, $$3$$, $$4$$, $$5$$, $$6$$, $$8$$.\nThe professors want to try a new clustering method called k-Medians, which works the same as k-Means, but with the cluster centers being located at the median of their data points instead of the mean. They initialize $$2$$ clusters centered at $$2$$ and $$7$$.
